package.title: Does Warfare Matter? Severity, Duration, and Outcomes of Civil Wars
package.artifact_note: The PDF/text shipped is the 2012 working-paper preprint, NOT the version of record for the stated DOI.

audit.engine: anomalyco/opencode (ReproAI) - DeepSeek V4 Flash via uniGPT
audit.mode: static audit + arithmetic internal-consistency checks in R 4.6.1

data_pipeline.primary_input: TR (Technologies of Rebellion) dataset, Kalyvas & Balcells 2010, based on Sambanis 2004 (147 wars, 1944-2004); PRIO100/UCDP-PRIO conflict-years (903, 1946-2008); battle deaths Lacina & Gleditsch 2005; COW Military Personnel; Fearon & Laitin 2003 controls
data_pipeline.models: Weibull AFT duration regression (Tables 1-2); OLS on log battledeaths (Tables 5-6); multinomial logit on outcomes (Tables 7-8)
data_pipeline.replication_availability: NONE located. No URL/data/code in the working-paper text (only 'Online Appendix' without URL). Harvard Dataverse title-exact search = 0 datasets; JCR dataverse returned no matching dataset. Primary input datasets are third-party and not shipped.

reimplementation.reason: No replication data or code obtainable; source-level coefficients cannot be independently reproduced.
reimplementation.what_was_done: Arithmetic internal-consistency checks of sample accounting and cross-table N totals from the paper's own reported numbers (exec_check/scripts/01_internal_consistency.R).
